没有可见手势控制、没有尺寸证明或不需要回归原状态的松散效果展示。

变化严格限制在注册框域内，人物身份、空间锚点和边界两侧位置不得漂移。
至少用三种框域尺寸证明同一规则；最大信息密度留到后段，再主动收束并完整回到基线。

card.mechanismEn: Follow one clearly adult original subject from behind through a coherent public route using imperfect handheld framing. card.mechanismEn: Keep one constrained optical observer interface visible throughout. Begin on a distant geographic anchor, find one anomalous structural cue, contract the field of view to a subject linked to that cue, stabilize a closer identity proof, then end on one micro-detail that visibly echoes the opening location. Every optical step must answer a narrower evidence question without switching to an omniscient camera.
